# WTP — The back office for private wealth

> WTP is a UAE-based back office for private wealth: banking access, corporate and
> holding structures, residency and succession — executed by a named in-house team.
> The UAE is WTP's home market, not the product it sells; work is executed in the
> jurisdiction that fits the client. Regulated services (legal, audit, licensed
> financial activities) are performed by licensed partners; WTP runs the process.

Key facts:
- Positioning: back office for private wealth (banking-first: bankability is designed before structures are built)
- Home market: United Arab Emirates (Dubai); cross-jurisdiction execution (UAE, Singapore, Portugal, Switzerland, Malta and others)
- Track record: 100+ UAE bank accounts opened; 90%+ of accepted cases reach a working account (pre-screen data)
- Model: pre-screen first — cases WTP cannot take are declined upfront
- Entity: Welcome to Paradise Real Estate Brokers L.L.C (Dubai, UAE)
